en.tagline: Premium roofing, restoration, and architectural excellence
en.heroHeadline: Your roof isn't just shelter. It's architecture.
en.heroSub: For 18 years, Precision Roofing has built roofs that last generations and look like they were meant to be there. We work with architects, general contractors, and homeowners who demand craftsmanship.
en.about: Precision Roofing is an established roofing and restoration firm serving Atlanta's architectural community for 18 years. We specialize in high-end residential and light commercial roofing, historic restoration, and architectural details. Every project is led by a master craftsman. We work with the region's top architects and builders.

services.name: Architectural roofing
services.blurb: High-end residential and commercial roofs designed with architects. Custom details, premium materials, lasting craftsmanship.
services.description: We work with architects and builders on custom roofing designs that integrate with the building's architectural vision. Every detail matters.

services.name: Historic restoration
services.blurb: Period-correct restoration of slate, tile, and copper roofs. Preserving Atlanta's architectural heritage.

services.name: Premium installation & maintenance
services.blurb: Master-level installation and long-term maintenance of premium roofing systems.

services.name: Consultations & design
services.blurb: Detailed roof consultations and design reviews for architects and builders. Technical specifications, material selection, phasing.

reviews.quote: We brought in Precision Roofing on a high-end residential project. Their attention to detail and collaboration with our architect was exceptional. The roof is stunning.
reviews.author: Anderson Architects

reviews.quote: Restored our 1950s home's original tile roof with period-correct materials and techniques. They understood the architectural significance and delivered perfection.
reviews.author: Eleanor H.

reviews.quote: Not just roofers. Craftsmen who understand architecture. Working with them elevated our entire project.
reviews.author: Sterling Builders

es.tagline: Techos premium, restauración y excelencia arquitectónica
es.heroHeadline: Tu techo no es solo refugio. Es arquitectura.
es.heroSub: Durante 18 años, Precision Roofing ha construido techos que duran generaciones y se ven como si estuvieran destinados a estar allí. Trabajamos con arquitectos, contratistas generales y propietarios que exigen artesanía.
es.about: Precision Roofing es una empresa establecida de techos y restauración que sirve a la comunidad arquitectónica de Atlanta durante 18 años. Nos especializamos en techos residenciales de alta gama y ligeramente comerciales, restauración histórica y detalles arquitectónicos. Cada proyecto es liderado por un maestro artesano. Trabajamos con los principales arquitectos y constructores de la región.

services.name: Techos arquitectónicos
services.blurb: Techos residenciales y comerciales de alta gama diseñados con arquitectos. Detalles personalizados, materiales premium, artesanía duradera.

services.name: Restauración histórica
services.blurb: Restauración históricamente correcta de techos de pizarra, baldosa y cobre. Preservando el patrimonio arquitectónico de Atlanta.

services.name: Instalación y mantenimiento premium
services.blurb: Instalación a nivel maestro y mantenimiento a largo plazo de sistemas de techos premium.

services.name: Consultas y diseño
services.blurb: Consultas detalladas de techos y revisiones de diseño para arquitectos y constructores. Especificaciones técnicas, selección de materiales, fases.

reviews.quote: Trajimos a Precision Roofing a un proyecto residencial de alta gama. Su atención a los detalles y colaboración con nuestro arquitecto fue excepcional. El techo es impresionante.
reviews.author: Anderson Architects

reviews.quote: Restauramos el techo original de baldosa de los años 50 de nuestro hogar con materiales y técnicas históricamente correctos. Entendieron la importancia arquitectónica y entregaron la perfección.
reviews.author: Eleanor H.

reviews.quote: No solo techadores. Artesanos que entienden la arquitectura. Trabajar con ellos elevó todo nuestro proyecto.
reviews.author: Sterling Builders
